resources.title: AuroraFlow Global
resources.author: MaZ3PlaYZ / MaZ3; based on CH360 Full Background Theme and Dark Ultimate/DASH menu assets
resources.description: Modern full-background Aurora skin with temperature/IP panels, green borders and a matching coverflow layout.
resources.prerequisites: Aurora 0.7 family, any Aurora language. Use the matching Global Modern by MaZ3 layout; language variants are not interchangeable.
setup: Copy AuroraFlow.Global.xzp into the Skins folder of your actual Aurora installation. Keep your existing XZP until the new skin is checked.
Copy Modern.by.MaZ3.Global.cfljson into Aurora\Media\Layouts\. Keep skin and layout language variants matched.
Press B → Skin and select AuroraFlow (Global). Disable Animation and select the matching Modern by MaZ3 layout. Restart Aurora.
resources.notes: Global supports all Aurora languages; English is explicitly English-only. Current README has an apparent destination typo (User/Backgrounds); original-author release/post and Aurora conventions put XZP files in Skins and CFLJSON layouts in Media/Layouts. Publisher skin.meta has trailing bytes after its first JSON object; the original asset is preserved byte-for-byte and hardware behavior is untested.

image.credit: MaZ3PlaYZ · official AuroraFlow interface screenshot from author repository; shared family preview

resources.title: NXE Splash + Avatar + Xbox logo
resources.author: Phoenix, Mynam3isnathan and Theodor94 / Theodor Andrei
resources.description: Default-style Aurora skin with an NXE-inspired splash, an avatar and Xbox-logo elements.
resources.prerequisites: Aurora 0.7 family (packaged skin.meta targets 0.7; skin.ver contains revision1622). No minimum system dashboard or motherboard is specified.
setup: Copy the original XZP to the Skins folder of your actual Aurora install via USB or FTP.
Press B → Skins and choose NXE Splash + Avatar + Xblogo. Restart Aurora.
Keep a working skin and file-manager recovery route before changing themes.
resources.notes: The author reports avatar prop animation is faster than normal. For personal use only; author grants no commercial or derivative-use license.

resources.title: Xbox ONE Experience · Aurora0.6b
resources.author: CEOISS / juanoliveira82; based on Aurora SteamOS by mrknorton
resources.description: Legacy Aurora skin with Xbox One / Windows10-inspired colors, buttons and layouts.
resources.prerequisites: Specifically Aurora0.6b as stated by the author. Packaged skin.ver is0.6 revision1238. Do not assume0.7b.2 support.
setup: Confirm you are using the source-pinned Aurora0.6b installation and retain the working skin.
Copy XboxOneExperience.xzp into that installation’s Skins folder. Do not unpack it or overwrite Default.xzp.
Select Xbox ONE Experience in Aurora’s B → Skin menu, then restart Aurora.
resources.notes: The repository ships a ready XZP directly; only that file was downloaded, not a repository/source archive. Original packaged metadata identifies author CEOISS, revision1, creationdate2017-06-05 and auroraver0.6.
